description: This file defines the NetworkMonitorClient class in the AWS SDK for PHP, used to interact with the Amazon CloudWatch Network Monitor service. It includes method annotations for operations such as creating, deleting, retrieving, listing, and updating monitors and probes, as well as managing resource tags.

classes.name: NetworkMonitorClient
classes.description: A client class that provides methods to interact with the Amazon CloudWatch Network Monitor service via AWS SDK for PHP.

methods.name: createMonitorAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new network monitor.

methods.name: createProbeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new network probe.

methods.name: getMonitor
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific network monitor.

methods.name: getProbe
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific network probe.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags for a specified resource.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists tags for a resource.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags from a resource.

methods.name: updateMonitor
methods.description: Updates information for a network monitor.

methods.name: updateProbe
methods.description: Updates information for a network probe.
